text: Given a group with fewer members than max_results, When graph_list_group_members is called, Then all members are returned and has_more=false
Given a group with more members than max_results, When called with that cap, Then exactly max_results members are returned and has_more=true
Given a group_id that does not exist, When graph_list_group_members is called, Then the response is a not_found error envelope, not an empty success
Given a real tenant group with more than one page of members, When walked page by page against the real tenant, Then full membership is reproduced with no duplicates or omissions
steps: Pick a real Entra ID group in the test tenant known to have more than 50 members (max_results default)
Call graph_list_group_members(group_id, max_results=50); record returned members and has_more
If has_more=true, call again walking pages until has_more=false
Cross-check the combined member list against the group's member count in the Entra admin portal
expect: Combined member count across pages equals the group's member count shown in the Entra admin portal; no member id repeated across pages

text: Given a cloud-only group (onPremisesSyncEnabled is None/false), When graph_get_group is called, Then sync_source="cloud-only"
Given an AD-synced group (onPremisesSyncEnabled=true), When graph_get_group is called, Then sync_source="on-premises" and onPremisesLastSyncDateTime is present
Given a group_id that does not exist, When graph_get_group is called, Then the response is a not_found error envelope
Given one real cloud-only group and, if available, one real AD-synced group, When graph_get_group is called against each, Then returned mailEnabled/sync_source match the Entra admin portal
steps: Identify a real cloud-only group and (if present in the test tenant) a real AD-synced group
Open the same group in the Entra admin portal and compare mail-enabled state and sync status
expect: mailEnabled and sync_source (and, for the AD-synced group, onPremisesLastSyncDateTime) match what the Entra admin portal shows

text: Given a tenant with multiple domains, When graph_list_domains is called, Then every domain is returned with correct isDefault/isVerified/authenticationType flags from the mocked response
Given a Graph response with an empty value array, When graph_list_domains is called, Then the tool returns an empty list, not an error
Given the real test tenant, When graph_list_domains is called, Then its output matches the domain list shown in the Entra admin portal
steps: Call graph_list_domains() against the real test tenant
Open the Entra admin portal's Domains page for the same tenant
Compare the two lists domain-by-domain, including isDefault/isVerified flags
expect: Domain names and flags returned by the tool match the admin portal exactly

text: Given a user whose proxyAddresses contains a value that is not their primary mail/UPN, When graph_check_user_exists(proxy_address=...) is called, Then exists=true with that user's profile, and the captured Graph request carries ConsistencyLevel: eventual, $count=true, and a correctly odata_quote-escaped $filter
Given no user has the given proxy address, When called, Then exists=false, not an error
Given zero or two-or-more of user_principal_name/mail/proxy_address are supplied, When graph_check_user_exists is called, Then it returns an invalid_argument error
Given a proxy_address value containing an apostrophe, When the tool builds its $filter, Then the value is escaped via odata_quote exactly as the existing mail/display_name filters are

Given a real user in the test tenant with a real secondary proxy address, When graph_check_user_exists(proxy_address=...) is called against that tenant, Then Graph accepts the advanced-query header/filter as documented and returns the expected match
steps: Identify a real user in the test tenant with a known secondary proxy address (not their primary mail/UPN)
Call graph_check_user_exists(proxy_address=<that value>) against the real tenant
Inspect the raw Graph response/status code
expect: exists=true with the correct user's profile; no 400/403 from Graph on the ConsistencyLevel/advanced-query request shape

text: Given the four tools are deployed, When a tenant admin opens Capabilities > Connectors > Microsoft Graph > Tools and clicks Refresh Tools, Then all four new tools appear in the connector's tool inventory
steps: Deploy the updated ms-graph-mcp container with the four new/changed tools
In agent.mspbots.ai, open Capabilities > Connectors > Microsoft Graph
Click Refresh Tools on the connector detail view
expect: graph_list_group_members, graph_get_group, graph_list_domains appear as new entries; graph_check_user_exists's tool description reflects the proxy_address option; no platform-side error or re-authorization prompt appears

text: Given two sequential calls carrying two different bearer tokens (simulating two tenants), When any of the four new/changed tools is invoked for each, Then each call's outbound Graph request carries only that call's own token, confirming no shared/cached client or cross-tenant leakage
